description: CC adapter (reference) vs RINO's local execution backend (candidate), RINO P2 first cut as planned in RINO's P0 mapping and spec Appendix B. Draft: tighten as RINO declares more. Every entry says why the difference is intended; anything not listed fails the diff.

allow.reason: RINO P2 v1 declares only tool.pre and turn.stop as gates; permission.request / input.request come after interrupt->resume is wired (spec Appendix B, staged declaration). Spec 4.2: MUST NOT list them until then.
Same staging: in headless cli, RINO's ApprovalGate Ask is a deny and the tool.pre gate is the only consumer decision point. Remove this entry when RINO declares the gates.
RINO has no subagents, worktrees, teammates, slash expansion, mid-run model switch or CC-style config/file hooks (P0 mapping 1, 1.1). Spec 4.1: undeclared events are not emitted.
In-process producer: no host hook timeout, so its own ceiling (RINO plans 600000) applies instead of CC's 180s-10s (spec 9.2).
RINO P2 first cut declares updated_input=false until its rule engine re-runs rules on rewritten input (P0 mapping Q5).
additional_context needs the adk TurnPreparer seam (decision-adk-fragment-seam, phase 3).
consumer.json may ask turn.stop for up to 300000; CC clamps to 170000, RINO can honour it (spec 9.2).
CC reports partially_applied when it clamps turn.stop or cannot gate an async hook; RINO may apply the same consumer.json fully.
RINO ships its own rules file in the same schema (tool_kinds instead of CC tool names), so the digest differs (P0 mapping Q9). Rule ids, status and required are still compared.
